note: The one place that sets the expiry dates of exceptions/exceptions.json. Placeholder policy: the project owner has no review date with the Trust Tasks task force yet, so the anchor is a calendar date and the offsets stagger the surfaces so that they do not all expire on one day. When a task-force review date is set, change the anchor (and, if wanted, the offsets) and run npm run regen; every entry's expires is rewritten from here, and npm run check:docs fails while an entry disagrees with this policy. Offsets are whole days after the anchor, per implementation key (one key per measured surface).
